step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture diagram shows an Angular Single Page Application (SPA) hosted in S3 and authenticated via AWS Cognito. The SPA connects to AWS AppSync as a unified GraphQL API. AppSync connects to two microservices represented by AWS Lambda functions: one for backend resolvers connecting to DynamoDB, and another for USGS weather data. Legacy relational data from an Oracle/VB6 application on-premises is synchronized into AWS via SNS, processed by an ingestion Lambda function, and written to DynamoDB using an adjacency list pattern.
